notes: North is up. Printed names: DREMAN (no suffix, recorded as Dreman Street as on sheets 607/609/610), ROLL AV., FOLLETT AV., RALSTON AV. (NOT OPEN), DIRR (no suffix, recorded as Dirr Street). The diagonal Follett and Follett Alley are not named on this sheet; names from sheet 610 (FOLLETT, FOLLETT ALLEY). Follett is in two pieces that do not line up at Dreman: the diagonal piece from the north ('Follett Avenue (north of Dreman)', T at x~1583) and FOLLETT AV. running south ('Follett Avenue', T at x~1952). The top band (y < ~160) shows the south ends of the sheet-610/611 blocks in outline. Roll and Follett run to the bottom edge. The Mill Creek and the lot lines in block 2 are ignored. Dreman centre lies ~15 px south of its water pipe; points are from the block faces. The narrow way at x~5240 (recorded in alleys) and the NE-running continuation of Dreman past its bend lead onto sheet 611; no names are printed for them here.
